bongo.name: Bongo one-shots (menegass)
bongo.attribution: Bongo samples by menegass (freesound.org), CC0 - credit not required
bongo.notes: Six single bongo hits from one uploader: open (high, bright), mid and low open tones, short hi/lo strokes used as tip/heel. Old (2010) recordings, single hits only, so it can sound mechanical; tap = the lowest open tone. Cut from HQ preview MP3s.

guira.name: VCSL güiro + cabasa
guira.attribution: Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL), Versilian Studios LLC
guira.notes: VCSL has no metal güira: gourd güiro (high-passed) layered with cabasa beads, premixed. Less metallic than a real güira.

bas.name: FreePats Finger Bass YR (Yamaha RBX)
bas.notes: Real fingerstyle electric bass, but the library has only ONE octave (MIDI 28-39). The app range 40-57 must repitch these up by 1-18 semitones, which sounds thin/chipmunky on high notes. Good only if the app plays bass an octave lower (28-45).

gitara.name: Spanish classical guitar, nylon (FreePats)
gitara.notes: Nylon-string classical guitar, single notes; recorded in non-ideal conditions and filtered (some noise/dullness). Softer and darker than the steel strings of modern bachata. No muted samples.

requinto.name: Spanish classical guitar, nylon (FreePats)
requinto.notes: Upper register of the nylon classical guitar. Warm, traditional (older) bachata colour; lacks the bright steel bite of modern requinto.
